title: Manage cookies consent and marketing preferences
summary: When deploying tracking or sending communications that require a reviewed permission and preference process. A tested preference system whose actual behavior matches the approved notices and consent rules.
outcomes: A tested preference system whose actual behavior matches the approved notices and consent rules.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When deploying tracking or sending communications that require a reviewed permission and preference process.

parts.title: Inventory tracking and messaging purposes
parts.guidance: List scripts, cookies, device identifiers, audiences and communication channels. Record who supplies each component and what data it collects before assuming a banner controls all processing.

parts.title: Determine the applicable permission model
parts.guidance: Privacy and marketing reviewers assess the actual jurisdictions, audience, purposes and channels. Document required consent, permitted alternatives and opt-out handling without reusing one market's rules globally.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

parts.title: Configure approved notices and preference controls
parts.guidance: Authorized operators implement the reviewed choices, suppression lists and tracking configuration. Avoid loading blocked components before the approved permission and retain the configuration version.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

parts.title: Test consent withdrawal and preference propagation
parts.guidance: Exercise first visit, acceptance, refusal, withdrawal and returning-user cases. Verify downstream analytics and messaging respect the recorded choices and identify vendors that do not receive updates.

parts.title: Approve release and monitor changes
parts.guidance: The accountable owners review test evidence and unresolved exceptions before launch. Reassess new scripts, channels or purposes and keep support and privacy-request routes available.
